content:
Hi everyone!

I am a masters student studying maths at Warwick University. I have previously taken a LEAN course at Warwick where I proved Riesz Representation Theorem in Mathlib. Whilst I enjoyed the learning process of mathematical formalisation, I found it very tricky. This is why I wanted to join this community to meet people for collaboration and to aid my learning!

Presently I am working on formalising Prime Orbit Theorem for shifts of finite type which is in the field of number theoretic dynamical systems. I am doing this for a summer research project with Warwick. Here is the repository. I will attempt to formalise up to section 3 in this dissertation
Aljalila.S_dissertation.pdf. Currently, I am having struggles with setting up definitions. For instance, a lot of sums and products are indexed using periodic orbits and prime periodic orbits, which I'm not too sure how to write up. I would greatly appreciate suggestions and feedback on my work so far!
